[p1]
MEMS 3D MATRIX SWITCH
SX3
DiCon’s MEMS 3D Matrix Optical Switch is a proprietary optical switch
structure built on DiCon’s industry-proven MEMS mirror technology
that enables any input to connect to any output in a stable, non-blocking
all-optical cross-connect configuration. Its superior optical performance
and reliability make it a versatile solution for routing both classical optical
signals as well as sensitive quantum information.
FEATURES APPLICATIONS
• No dithering or active alignment artifacts • Quantum Computing / Communication
• High Reliability / Stability • Cyber Surveillance
• Lifetime > 1 Billion Switch Cycles • Data Center Network
• Available in any MxN configuration up to 96x96 • Configurable Test & Measurement
• Proven MEMS Technology
